title: Meganet Technologies Global ₹740-crore IPO: Fresh issue, OFS details - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Meganet Technologies Global, which makes servers for AI workloads and data centres, has filed draft papers for a ₹740-crore IPO. | Photo Credit: iStockphoto

* Meganet Technologies Global on Monday filed draft papers for an initial public offering (IPO) to raise ₹740 crore ($78.62 million).

* The AI infrastructure provider, which makes servers for high-performance computing, data centres and AI workloads, will issue fresh shares worth up to ₹140 crore.

* - Existing shareholders will sell shares worth up to ₹600 crore through an offer for sale (OFS).

* The company provides hardware to customers, including data centre provider Yotta Data Services and brokerage Motilal Oswal Financial Services.

* It has built sourcing partnerships with technology providers such as Nvidia and AMD.

* The IPO comes amid a surge in Indian companies looking to capitalise on the global AI race in the public markets, as well as a string of data centre investments in the country through the year.
